title: Job Receipt
description: Input contract for the Job Receipt template: the slip a customer gets when the shop receives a repair or a print job, on A5 or a 58/80 mm receipt roll (`paper`). Strings that do not apply are "". See the sibling .json for a worked example.

paper.description: A5 sheet or a 58/80 mm receipt roll.

logoUrl.description: Shop logo as an http(s) URL or data: URI; "" for none.

receivedOn.description: The day the job was received, e.g. 20 Nov 2026.

receivedAt.description: The time the job was received, e.g. 14:35.

title.description: Repair: the device. Print job: the kind of print.

detail.description: Repair: what the customer reported. Print job: the quantity and kind of print.

serialNumber.description: The device's serial or IMEI; "" when none.

itemLines.description: Repair: the work planned, one line each. Print job: empty.

estimateCents.description: The estimate in cents; null while nothing is quoted.

promisedReadyOn.description: The promised ready day, e.g. 27 Nov 2026; null when none.

isWarrantyRework.description: A free rework job opened from a warranty claim; the estimate prints as No charge.

qrData.description: What the QR code holds: the ticket number, which the till's scan box accepts.

termsText.description: The shop's terms for jobs; "" prints none.

uncollectedAfterDays.description: Days after which an uncollected job may be disposed of; null prints no warning.
